limitations: Historical auth provenance incomplete; not retrospectively repaired
No formal timing indistinguishability; observed auth timing differences remain
Single-instance in-memory auth rate limiting; no distributed business limiter
Trusted local host/daemon, linux/amd64, local self-signed TLS, manual crash recovery
Known-value/heuristic scans non-exhaustive; no packet capture guarantee about attempted egress
SQL-owned FK absent from ORM relation graph requires explicit constraint checks and reviewed drift
No RLS, no archived restore/view, no exactly-once mutation guarantee, no paginated snapshot
